description: Deep within Stranglethorn Vale, Witch Doctor Unbagwa claims to know how to draw out the beast known as Mokk the Savage. Before communion with the spirits…
intro: Deep within Stranglethorn Vale, Witch Doctor Unbagwa claims to know how to draw out the beast known as Mokk the Savage. Before communion with the spirits can begin, the witch doctor requires ten Gorilla Fangs as an offering. Once the ritual commences, defending the troll from agitated jungle beasts is necessary to lure the creature forth.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Witch Doctor Unbagwa know what Mokk the Savage like. Yes, yes!
Me speak with spirits and make he come, I do.
But other Gorilla-beast like spirit talkin' too. You protect Witch Doctor Unbagwa and I make he come to you.
Witch Doctor Unbagwa want something first. You bring 10 Gorilla Fangs and me start spirit talking!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Witch Doctor Unbagwa like Gorilla Fangs! For you I talk to spirits. Make Mokk the Savage come.
You protect Witch Doctor Unbagwa from other Gorilla-beast though or no Mokk for you!
